title: Monthly tune-up
description: 10 minutes once a month keeps your computer running smoothly.

items.text: Restart the computer (not just sleep — a full restart)
items.hint: Click Start → Power → Restart. This clears out things running in the background.
Click Start → Settings → Windows Update → Check for updates.
Right-click the Recycle Bin on your desktop, then click "Empty Recycle Bin."

items.text: Check how full your main drive is
items.hint: Open the Disk Report in PC Helper. If it's over 80% full, follow the guide to free up space.

items.text: Make sure your backup is up to date
items.hint: Open the Backup screen in PC Helper. The last backup should be within the past week.

items.text: Make sure Windows Defender is on and up to date
items.hint: Click Start → Settings → Privacy & Security → Windows Security → Virus & threat protection. It should say "No action needed."
